page.content:
Wildemount campaign of the Mighty Nein, from Trostenwald to the Assembly.

How Campaign 2 connects

  • Faction: Mighty Nein — The Mighty Nein are the player party of Campaign 2.
  • Topic: Critical Role — Campaign 2 is Critical Role's Wildemount campaign.
  • Character: Matthew Mercer — Mercer DMs Campaign 2 for the Mighty Nein.
  • Work: Campaign 1 — Campaign 1 ended before Campaign 2 began.
  • Work: Campaign 3 — Campaign 2 ended before Campaign 3 began.
  • Location: Wildemount — Campaign 2 is set largely in Wildemount.

What is Campaign 2?

Campaign 2 follows the Mighty Nein through Wildemount: the Empire–Dynasty war, the Angel of Irons, and the Assembly, with Jester, Caleb, and Fjord at the party's center.

Key threads lead to Mighty Nein, Critical Role, Matthew Mercer, Campaign 1, Campaign 3 and Wildemount.
